description: C0 (MP3+FLAC, no swresample) + AAC capability: AAC-LC in MOV/MP4/M4A and raw ADTS AAC. First stage that pays the MOV/MP4 container cost plus the AAC decoder cost.

capability:mov/mp4/m4a -> AAC decoder.reason: issue #8 capability intent: MOV/MP4/M4A container must hand AAC-LC packets to the AAC decoder (demuxer mov covers mov,mp4,m4a,3gp,3g2,mj2)

demuxer:aac.reason: raw ADTS AAC streams are their own container (demuxer aac)

decoder:aac.reason: only AAC decoder in the C1 corpus; AAC-LC only, no HE-AAC edge profiles unless real files demand them
